decisions.reason: Training is a low-cost complementary service with stable demand, so the option is cheap to keep.
The rotary axis accessory supports existing machines and can be kept at low cost while its market is still being evaluated.
Hybrid additive post-processing has not shown enough value after three years and absorbs resources that can be better used elsewhere.
The high-speed CNC milling machine is core to the firm's product range and warrants continued commitment.
The automatic tool change system is a modular accessory with expected demand and low incremental cost to retain.
